name: Voice-path comfort noise off
about: Diagnostic patch, untested on hardware. The HFP/SCO voice path runs an STFT noise suppressor (FUN_00c780a4) whose mode flags come from the compiled-in config block at FIRM 0xC33D9C. Flag bit 1 turns on minimum-tracking noise estimation (FUN_00c77864) and comfort-noise fill (FUN_00c77dc4): every bin whose gain-scaled power drops under the noise floor is replaced by a random-phase bin at noise level, which is heard as hiss/crackle on quiet audio. Stock flags are 6 (bits 1+2); 4 keeps the cross-bin gain smoothing (bit 2) and drops the noise fill. See docs/23-low-volume-noise.md.

settings.name: ns_flags
settings.what: short [1] of the voice NS config block at FIRM 0xC33D9C, copied to module +8 by FUN_00c782d8(0xa900); bit0 adaptive noise estimate (FUN_00c77a68), bit1 noise tracking + comfort-noise fill, bit2 gain smoothing (FUN_00c77980)
